message: body references `message_role` but nothing declares it. Put it in this module's `ontology`, in `requires` (another clause defines it), or in `inputs` (a fact about the case). ⚠️ A `concepts` entry alone does NOT declare it — concepts carry meaning, not provenance; `message_role/N` must ALSO appear in one of those three. An undeclared name cannot be told apart from a typo
